review_description: The quote we received after a quick phone call and chat about options was easy. The written quote was broken down to explain the items and the cost.      The quote was the cheapest of all quotes. Leroy the owner was great.    He kept me informed. Arrived on time. Cleaned the roof of debris. Installed.    Cleaned up everything and explained how to get the app on my phone.    Great service. Everyone working with him was great.

Right from the first phone call when we spoke to Liam he was straight on to our situation and asked for a copy of our latest energy bill to ascertain our usage. From then on it became obvious we were dealing with a company with our best interests at heart. We were given two quotes with all details and prices and eventually settled on a 7.6Kw system for a very competative price. The installation was very quick and they took the time to explain everything about the new system that is working nicely. We couldn't be happier! Thankyou Solar Quotes and Leroy & Liam from Sol Energy and Storage.
The installation process was easy and 100% completed to a high standard! Excellent and responsible technician
Very professional and good job. Arrived on time and got the job done thanks
First-class service from start to finish.On time, pleasant to deal with and went out of their way to show us the system and how to make the most out of it.

A very professional team that have done a great job installing both solar panels and batteries to our home. They did the work in  time and on time and were great at explaining how everything worked. Leroy goes over and above with his service and i  would recommend this company to anyone who are after solar systems.

Had these guys come out to remove an old system and install a newer one.I was very impressed with the customer service and amount of knowledge they had regarding renewable energy.They even spent the time after the install to set up an app on my phone which allows me to monitor it from anywhere! (I’m old)Couldn’t recommend them highly enough.
